description: Please fill this Google form to confirm your team:- https://forms.gle/nqSv46QRVhWVv4pBA All Participants must join the WhatsApp group for further doubts and details :- https://chat.whatsapp.com/GdpvDiR9Epi9JnqDMFedKl?s=cl&p=i&mlu=4&ilr=4 Overview This is a Capture The Flag (CTF): a set of security puzzles built to be solved. Each challenge hides a secret text called a flag. Find it, submit it on the scoreboard and earn points. The highest score at the end wins. You are not expected to know everything. Searching, experimenting and taking notes is part of the game. Guidelines: Register on the portal (one account per team), then log in. Open Challenges and click a challenge to read its description and points. Use the resource link in the challenge to reach its files or service. Investigate, find the flag, and submit it in the challenge window. Watch your rank on the Scoreboard. Rulebook: https://tinyurl.com/NJACKRulebook Disclaimer: A dead end, a decoy or a rejected flag-lookalike is part of the challenge. A service that keeps failing, a corrupt file, a correct flag being rejected, or a stage you can reach without the previous one may be a bug. If you suspect a bug, stop, contact the admins privately with the challenge name, what you did and when, and tell no one else. Do not use a bug to score. Disqualification follows: sharing flags or solutions, multiple accounts, denial of service, attacking the scoreboard or infrastructure, scanning internal networks, bypassing the submission limit, exploiting a bug without reporting it, ignoring a warning about prohibited tools, or dishonesty during a review. Minor issues may get a warning first. Organizer decisions are final, and review requests must be made within 24 hours. Play hard. Play clean.
